stories.title: Newsom commutes all 548 California death row sentences
stories.line: California's governor is commuting all 548 death row sentences, converting them to life without parole before leaving office.

stories.title: Tech stocks shed $2 trillion on fears of AI rules after Democrats win Congress
stories.line: Tech stocks lost about $2 trillion as investors feared a midterm-driven crackdown on AI companies.

stories.title: Wisconsin infant dies of measles, state's first such death since 1990
stories.line: A Wisconsin infant died of measles, the state's first measles death in 36 years, amid 431 cases, nearly all unvaccinated.

stories.title: Meta indefinitely pauses its new commercial terms, which critics say would let it scrape sites of business users, after publisher outcry and court injunctions (Nieman Lab)
Melania Trump hails six-day Oleshky ceasefire, calls for lasting Ukraine truce
stories.line: A six-day Oleshky ceasefire in Ukraine was hailed by Melania Trump, with Russian and Ukrainian officials in Washington calling for a lasting truce.

stories.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats incumbent Karen Bass in Los Angeles mayoral race
stories.line: Los Angeles voters chose democratic socialist council member Nithya Raman over incumbent Mayor Karen Bass, who conceded.

stories.title: Colom narrowly leads Hyde-Smith in too-close-to-call Mississippi Senate race
stories.line: Democrat Scott Colom narrowly leads Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in a Mississippi Senate race too close to call, with ballots still being counted.

stories.title: Hegseth under fire from both parties as Trump weighs replacements
stories.line: Hegseth faces impeachment threats and reported replacement talks as Republicans blame him for midterm losses while he vows to continue the Iran war.

stories.title: Trump moves to make Oval Office and two White House rooms a national monument
stories.line: Trump signed a proclamation to shield recent Oval Office and White House room redecorations from future changes by designating them a national monument.
